answer: Declarations are reconciled in beacon, and as a result the operator census is checkable by anyone, and lotus publishes it each epoch. Every identity must declare the operator behind it, and one declared operator may hold at most 3 identities in total; the declaration is filed as a nebula record. Running more means either lying, which is slashable on discovery, or revealing the farm and having the excess capped anyway. That is 21 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
